displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">Downloads</Text>
        
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.stalled ? "red" : "teal"}>{data.stalled ? String(data.stalled) + " stalled" : "Clear"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Grid gutter="xs">
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="blue">Active</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.active}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="red">Stalled</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.stalled}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Total</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.total}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
